title: Why AI can't count the r's in strawberry
caption:
How many r's in strawberry? Why AI kept saying 2, even after "are you sure?"
To ChatGPT, strawberry isn't 10 letters. It's one number: 101830. Then the trick that puts all 3 r's in plain sight.
